Track: the base class of igvShiny's S4 tracks

Source: R/tracks.R
Track-class.Rd

Track holds the slots every igv.js track shares. It is the parent of igvAnnotationTrack and QuantitativeTrack; build tracks with their subclass constructors, e.g. DataFrameAnnotationTrack, and display them with loadTrack.

Usage

Track(
  trackType = c("annotation", "quantitative", "alignment", "variant", "gwas",
    "genomicAlignment", "remoteAlignment", "pairedEndAnnotation"),
  sourceType = c("file", "url", "gcs", "ga4gh"),
  fileFormat = c("bed", "gff", "gff3", "gtf", "wig", "bigWig", "bedGraph", "bam", "vcf",
    "seg", "gwas", "cram", "bedpe"),
  trackName,
  onScreenOrder = NA_real_,
  color = "gray",
  height = 50,
  autoTrackHeight = FALSE,
  minTrackHeight = 50,
  maxTrackHeight = 500,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

Arguments

trackType

One of "annotation", "quantitative", "alignment", "variant", "gwas", "genomicAlignment", "remoteAlignment", "pairedEndAnnotation"

sourceType

One of "file", "url", "gcs", "ga4gh"

fileFormat

One of "bed", "gff", "gff3", "gtf", "wig", "bigWig", "bedGraph", "bam", "vcf", "seg", "gwas", "cram", "bedpe"

trackName

A character string, used as track label by igv; we recommend unique names per track

onScreenOrder

Numeric, for explicit placement of track within the current set

color

A CSS color name (e.g., "red" or "#FF0000"), or "random"

height

track height in pixels

autoTrackHeight

If TRUE, track height is adjusted dynamically, within the bounds set by minTrackHeight and maxTrackHeight

minTrackHeight

In pixels, minimum allowed

maxTrackHeight

In pixels, maximum allowed

visibilityWindow

Maximum window size in base pairs for which indexed annotations or variants are displayed

Value

An object of class Track

Slots

trackType

character, e.g. "annotation" or "quantitative"

sourceType

character, e.g. "file" or "url"

fileFormat

character, e.g. "bed" or "bedGraph"

trackName

character, the track label

onScreenOrder

numeric, explicit placement of the track

color

character, a CSS color

height

numeric, track height in pixels

autoTrackHeight

logical; stored, not sent to igv.js yet

minTrackHeight

numeric, pixels; stored, not sent to igv.js yet

maxTrackHeight

numeric, pixels; stored, not sent to igv.js yet

visibilityWindow

numeric, base pairs; sent to igv.js by the annotation and quantitative loadTrack methods (NA: not sent)

References

https://igv.org/doc/igvjs/#tracks/Tracks/

Examples

track <- Track(trackType = "annotation", sourceType = "file",
               fileFormat = "bed", trackName = "demo", color = "red")
trackInfo(track)
#> $trackType
#> [1] "annotation"
#> 
#> $fileFormat
#> [1] "bed"
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "file"
#> 
#> $class
#> [1] "Track"
#>
